why: This week is Math. The range has at most 900 three-digit numbers, so check each one for three pairwise distinct digits. With a digit-DP mindset you could also count combinatorially (9*9*8 = 648 over all 100..999), but the brute force is well within limits.
hints: Every number in range has exactly 3 digits.
A number qualifies when its three digits are pairwise different: len(set(str(x))) == 3.
Loop x from l to r and count. O(r - l).
pitfalls: Both ends of the range are inclusive.
Leading zeros are impossible here, so 0 can still appear as the middle or last digit (890 counts).
